title: Lines of code got a better publicist
summary: This article discusses the limitations of using Lines of Code (LOC) as a metric for measuring software developer productivity, and explores why this metric persists despite widespread criticism from the software engineering community.
problem_solved: Addresses the misunderstanding that more lines of code equals more productivity or value in software development.
why_valuable: It challenges a deeply ingrained but flawed industry metric, encouraging teams to focus on meaningful outcomes rather than vanity metrics.
